Step 5b is **not closed**. I repaired two defects in the vertex-module item: its shift degree had the wrong sign, and Fact L4 attributed finite generation to a lemma that does not state it. The repair, direct-consumer checks, 43 edge verdicts, and local validation are recorded in the [5b report](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-35-ten-categories-alpha-5b.md).

The post-5a impact review passes for all 11 affected items. Two blockers remain: six forward references have no justified verdict under the gate’s allowed choices, and the pre-author impact window still has 5,877 pending reviews. The cross-group checker fails only on those six forward references. The engine should retain the Step 5b hold; the [decisions file](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-35-ten-categories-alpha-5b-decisions.json) records each unresolved obligation.
